data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘basm’, meaning ‘to ripen’ or ‘to become ripe’. In Islamic culture, Basama represents the fruitfulness of life and the maturation of spiritual growth. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
